# svg-slides set: Glassmorphism (`glass`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Glassmorphism: a deep indigo field with violet, blue and cyan glow blobs built from stacked translucent circles (the designs forbid gradient defs and filters, so the soft edge is a banded approximation), frosted glass cards (translucent white fill, thin light border, rounded corners) holding thin-weight white text in a light Segoe UI-style head over a sans body, cyan and violet accents. The light theme is light glass on a pale sky field with dark text. Not any template's brand.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set glass --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- Glassmorphism UI write-ups (frosted translucent panels, 1 px light borders, vivid blurred backgrounds, rounded 16 to 20 px corners).
- Windows 11 / iOS translucent-material design language: thin type, soft glow behind frosted cards.

slots, not literal hues: `--teal` is this set's primary. `--block` / `--on-block` are the
colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: deep field with stacked-circle glow blobs; one frosted card (translucent fill, light border, 22 px corners) holds all the text flush left. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: the chapter number in a frosted card over a violet glow; eyebrow, two-line thin title and orientation line to its right. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide: one wide frosted card over cyan and violet glows holds the eyebrow, a three-line statement and the attribution. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Content slide: body text, key point and graphic each in a frosted card over soft glow blobs; thin heading above, caption under the graphic. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: a large frosted card for the graphic and a narrow frosted card for the takeaway over glow blobs. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: one large frosted card over three glows holds the title, up to three contact lines and the meta line. |
